queueFinished.title: Queue finished
queueFinished.body: Finished downloading {n} item | Finished downloading {n} items

resolve.photosOnly: This post has photos, not a video. Photo downloads are coming soon.

errors.notFound404: This file could not be found. It may be private or removed. Check the link with its owner.
errors.fileNotPublic: This file isn't shared publicly. Ask the owner to share it with anyone who has the link.
errors.fileRateLimited: This site is limiting downloads right now. Try again later.
errors.fileAddressRefused: This file link cannot be reached safely. Use a public HTTP or HTTPS link.
errors.fileNetwork: The download was interrupted. Try resuming it, or copy a fresh link.
errors.fileEncoding: The server changed how it sends this file. Try another download link.
errors.fileState: The saved download could not be verified. Choose another folder to start again.
errors.fileBusy: This file is already downloading. Wait for it to finish.
errors.fileIo: The file could not be saved. Check the folder and available space, then try again.
errors.fileChanged: The file changed on the server. Try the download again.
errors.fileNotFile: The site sent a page instead of the file. Copy a fresh direct download link.
errors.fileEmpty: The server sent an empty file. Try another download link.
errors.fileSpace: There is not enough space for this file. Free some space or choose another folder.
errors.fileProxy: File downloads cannot use this proxy safely yet. Turn off the proxy to download this file.
